title: Zombieland

    Quick PlaysDouble tap loaded potato skinsRule 2 is the double tap. Twice-baked skins with bacon and cheddar.How to make it6 medium potatoes, scrubbed2 tbsp olive oil4 rashers of bacon, chopped150g cheddar, grated125g sour cream3 spring onions, slicedRub the potatoes with oil and salt and bake at 200°C until tender.Fry the bacon until crisp.Halve the potatoes, scoop out most of the flesh and save it for mash.Fill the skins with bacon and cheddar and bake again until crisp and melted.Top with sour cream and spring onion.Enjoy the little things mini corn dogsRule 32 is enjoy the little things. Cocktail franks in sweet corn batter.How to make it16 cocktail frankfurts16 short bamboo skewers100g fine cornmeal100g self-raising flour1 tbsp caster sugar1 egg180ml milk1 L vegetable oil, for frying4 tbsp yellow mustard4 tbsp tomato saucePat the franks dry and push a skewer into each.Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, salt, egg and milk into a thick batter and pour it into a tall glass.Dip each frank in the batter and fry in oil at 180°C, turning, until deep golden.Drain and serve with mustard and tomato sauce.Free Parking buttered popcornThe best thing about Zombieland.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Main GamesRiviera club sandwiches with friesBill Murray just played nine holes. Turkey, bacon and tomato in toasted triple decks.How to make it12 slices of white sandwich bread300g shaved roast turkey8 rashers of bacon2 tomatoes, sliced1 baby cos lettuce6 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise1kg frozen shoestring fries16 toothpicksBake the fries at 220°C until crisp.Fry the bacon until crisp.Toast the bread and spread each slice with mayonnaise.Layer turkey, lettuce, bacon and tomato over three slices per sandwich.Pin with toothpicks, cut into triangles and serve with the fries.Mad cow double cheeseburgersIt all started with mad cow disease. Two smashed beef patties and American cheese.How to make it600g beef mince, 20 percent fat8 slices of American cheese4 soft potato buns1 brown onion, very finely sliced4 dill pickles, sliced4 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise2 tbsp tomato sauce1 tbsp yellow mustardRoll the mince into 8 balls and stir the mayonnaise, tomato sauce and mustard together.Heat a heavy pan until smoking, add a ball with some onion on top and smash it flat with a spatula.Cook until the edges crisp, flip, add cheese and stack two patties per burger.Toast the buns, spread with sauce and build with the patties and pickles.Bonus RoundDeep-fried Twinkies with vanilla ice creamThe last Twinkies in the universe. Battered hot and dusted with icing sugar.How to make it8 Hostess Twinkies, frozen8 short bamboo skewers150g self-raising flour1 egg200ml milk1 L vegetable oil, for frying2 tbsp icing sugar500ml vanilla ice creamWhisk the flour, egg and milk into a smooth batter.Skewer the frozen Twinkies and dip them in the batter.Fry at 180°C for 2 to 3 minutes until golden, then drain.Dust with icing sugar and serve with ice cream.RefillsNut up or shut up peanut butter shakesTime to nut up or shut up. Peanut butter and banana blended thick.How to make it2 ripe bananas, sliced and frozen4 tbsp smooth peanut butter500ml vanilla ice cream500ml milk2 tbsp chocolate toppingBlend the banana, peanut butter, ice cream and milk until thick.Swirl chocolate topping round 4 glasses and pour in the shakes.Pacific Playland blue slushiesEvery machine switched on.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
